priceSnapshot.note: THE REGIME CHANGED AT 15:15Z AND EVERY LEVEL IN THE MIDNIGHT REPORT IS NOW HISTORY. Midnight published at 64,285.2 with the market pinned under a daily ema50 it had failed at four times, and set an add gate at 64,364.8. That gate cleared, and then the market kept going: the 15:00Z hourly bar opened 65,928.6 and printed a 69,675.2 high inside fifteen minutes, a 3,746-point vertical range on a single 15m candle. The catalyst is documented and external - the SEC formally proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, a capital-raising exemption framework and investment-contract safe harbour for digital-asset issuers - and it repriced the whole complex, not just the perp: MSTR is 103.44, up 11.80 percent, and COIN is 160.87, up 10.01 percent, both verified live at 1:52 PM EDT. changePct is plus 5.44 percent against the 64,707.8 rolling 24-hour open. Against midnight's own 64,285.2 snapshot price is 3,940.6 points higher, plus 6.13 percent. The high has NOT held: spot is 1,449.4 points off the 69,675.2 print, a 2.08 percent fade over the two and a half hours since, and the last three 15m bars have been building a base between 67,828.2 and 68,256.0 rather than extending.

Losing it says the SEC candle is being distributed rather than absorbed, and the next real shelf is 67,500 where 3.23 million dollars of shorts were force-covered on the way up.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $68,924.3 - the DAILY 200-period EMA, recomputed this run from a 200-bar window of OKX index dailies. This is the single most important number on the page and it has not been reclaimed on a closing basis at any point in this recovery. The 69,675.2 spike pierced 750.9 points through it for less than one 15m bar and was rejected. A settled hourly close above it would be the first genuine break of the multi-month downtrend average rather than a news wick, and it is also where the last untested short-liquidation inventory sits at 69,000 and 69,300.

decisionBox.changed: COMPLETELY, AND THE HONEST ANSWER IS THAT MIDNIGHT WAS RIGHT AND TOO SMALL. Midnight flipped to ADD at 64,285.2, bought a 12 USDT tranche into a cleared long-liquidation shelf, and explicitly held roughly 24 USDT back for a 64,050 retest that never came; that tranche is now up 6.07 percent and the reserve earned nothing. This desk does not chase what it already owns. The stance flips from ADD to TAKE_PROFIT for reasons that are about position management, not about turning bearish: the 1H RSI is 83.9, the 4H is 79.8, price is 3,359.3 points above the 1H ema20 it left behind, and 74.1 million dollars of short liquidations - twenty-seven times the long side - have already been harvested between 15:24Z and now. The fuel that carried this move has been burned. A stop is NOT recommended because the wallet is banking the gain outright rather than defending it, and because the next report is roughly 6.6 hours away rather than overnight.

What the cluster tells you is where the crowd was positioned and therefore where the supply now sits, so treat it as overhead resistance that has already done its work, not as a target that will pull price up a second time.

liquidations.note: MEASURED, FRESH, AND THE MOST ONE-SIDED READING THIS FILE HAS EVER RECORDED. The 1,600 fills returned cover 2026-08-19T15:24:27Z to 17:48:37Z and split 74,140,988 dollars of SHORT liquidations against 2,743,168 of long - a 27-to-1 ratio, and 1,084 times the entire 68,352 dollars midnight measured on the long side seven hours earlier. skew is the OKX long/short ACCOUNT ratio at 1.11 for the 17:00Z hour, and its path is the most interesting number in this report: 1.24 at 14:00Z, 1.19 at 15:00Z, 1.13 at 16:00Z, 1.11 now. Accounts got LESS long through a 5.4 percent rally, which means this was shorts being removed rather than longs being added. Open interest agrees and settles the argument: 2,127,137,070 dollars against midnight's 2,119,634,571, a rise of just 0.35 percent across a move that added 3,940 points to price. A news-driven rally that barely adds leverage is a healthier rally than one that does - but it also means there is no crowded long to squeeze out on a pullback, so support has to come from real bids. Funding is 0.0100 percent for the 00:00Z settlement, a normal positive number and nowhere near the froth this size of candle usually produces.

calibration.note: The prior report is 2026-08-19-midnight, published at 02:05:00-05:00 with spot at 64,285.2. There was no morning session today - the manifest carries morning as null - so this bias review compares against midnight rather than against a -morning.json that does not exist. MIDNIGHT WAS RIGHT AND UNDERSIZED. Its reduce line at 64,042.2 never fired: the lowest print since publication is 64,178.7, some 136.5 points above it, so priorReduceFired is false. Its add gate at 64,364.8 cleared decisively and price is now 3,861.0 points through it. The mechanism it named was correct too - it argued that a cleared long-liquidation shelf with the tape flipping to short liquidations was a base rather than a knife, and the market spent seven hours proving it before the SEC headline detonated. The 12 USDT tranche it deployed at 64,285.2 is worth 12.73 at 68,225.8, plus 6.13 percent. The criticism is one of sizing, not direction: it explicitly held roughly 24 USDT back for a 64,050 retest that never came, and that reserve earned nothing through the largest single-session move in this file's history. The lesson for the wallet is that when a report's own reasoning says the shelf is cleared, the reserve earmarked for a lower shelf is being held against a scenario the report has already argued against. Acting helped: yes.
